{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Continuous Integration
env:
 CLOUDSDK_PYTHON: python3.13
on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

permissions: {}

jobs:
  python_tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
        with:
          node-version: '24.x'

      - name: set up Java JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@77dd5b2ce225ea11469928ac317850245a74ae78 # v6.2.0
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '25'

      - name: set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0 # v7
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: pre-installation
        run: |
          # Remove existing google-cloud-sdk packages in Ubuntu.
          sudo rm -rf /usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk
          curl https://dl.google.com/dl/cloudsdk/channels/rapid/downloads/google-cloud-sdk-497.0.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz | tar -zx > /dev/null
          # Substitute the downloaded google-cloud-sdk packages, due to https://stackoverflow.com/questions/42697026/install-google-cloud-components-error-from-gcloud-command.
          sudo mv google-cloud-sdk /usr/lib/
          sudo gcloud components update
          sudo gcloud components install app-engine-python beta cloud-datastore-emulator app-engine-python-extras
          gcloud config set project cr-status-staging
          gcloud version

      - name: installation
        run: |
          npm config set script-shell bash --global
          make setup

      - name: lint
        run: make lint

      - name: mypy
        run: make mypy

      - name: test
        run: npm test

      - name: build
        run: make build
",
  "rationale": "The retrieved evidence (experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2) demonstrates a measured CI workflow on a fork where adding a pip dependency cache step reduced installation time. This workflow sets up Python 3.13 and subsequently runs `make setup` which installs Python dependencies. The repository contains a pyproject.toml file at the root, satisfying the cache key requirement. Adding the cache step after Python setup and before the pre-installation phase is a low-risk, evidence-supported optimization that preserves all existing build, lint, test, and type-check steps without altering their behavior or coverage.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}
